title: PageTabs
description: A strip of open application pages (route navigation, not an ARIA tablist): the application owns routes, closing and unsaved-change guards. Items are flat rounded surfaces; long titles are truncated and shown in full in a tooltip; the current page stays in view and scroll buttons appear when the list overflows.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Each PageTab has a label button (aria-current="page" when active) and an optional separate action such as a close button. When the focused item is closed, focus moves to the current page.

context-menu.title: Context menu and actions
context-menu.description: Wrap items in a ContextMenu for per-page commands; actions renders global controls outside the scrolling list.

overflow.title: Overflow and disabled
overflow.description: When the pages overflow, scroll buttons appear and the active page is scrolled into view. Disabled pages cannot be selected and show no tooltip.

PageTabsProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the navigation landmark (e.g. "Open pages")
PageTabsProps.activeValue: Value of the current route's item. When it (or the set of items) changes, the active item is scrolled into view
PageTabsProps.actions: Global actions shown after the scrollable list (e.g. a page menu)
PageTabsProps.scrollLeftLabel: Accessible label of the "scroll left" button
PageTabsProps.scrollRightLabel: Accessible label of the "scroll right" button

PageTabProps.ref: Ref to the item wrapper element
PageTabProps.value: Identifier of the page (exposed as data-value)
PageTabProps.label: Title of the page; truncated with an ellipsis, shown in full in a tooltip
PageTabProps.active: Marks the item as the current page (aria-current="page")
PageTabProps.disabled: Disables the label button (the separate action keeps its own state)
PageTabProps.action: Separate control rendered next to the label (e.g. a close IconButton)
PageTabProps.onSelect: Called when the label button is activated
